articles.summary: Last holiday season, ​​retail mobile commerce (m-commerce) sales alone grew 14.5% to reach $125.60 billion, and estimates indicate that over 50% of all e-commerce purchases this year will be made on smartphones. Mobile shoppers expect seamless, secure, and fast mobile experiences, and to capture their attention, brands need to provide an easy-to-use experience tailored for smaller screens, on-the-go shopping, and touch interactions.
articles.title: Mobile Shopping Trends and Expectations for the 2024 Holiday Season
